title: App Statistic handles session redirects and non-JSON responses without parsing login HTML
steps: Run the statistics client tests against redirects, permission denial, HTML and malformed JSON responses.
Confirm list and detail use manual redirects and distinguish a sign-in requirement from server failures.
expect: A valid JSON response retains credentials and is read without alteration.
A sign-in redirect including browser opaqueredirect requests sign-in and is never parsed as JSON.
Forbidden, HTTP failure, HTML and invalid JSON produce distinct readable errors.
Detail uses the same response protection and cancellation is preserved.
fence: Deterministic fetch stubs assert the actual client helper contract; no session token, backend admission or user identity is fabricated.

tests: statistics reads keep credentials, request JSON and stop login redirects before parsing
expired session responses request sign-in without parsing HTML, including browser opaque redirects
forbidden, failed, HTML and invalid JSON statistics responses have distinct readable errors
detail reads share the same protection and preserve aborted request cancellation
